clues: This city lies in a wide farm valley in the middle of California. It is the biggest city of its valley and its whole central zone.
Winds pour down the long valley from the northwest most of the year. They help keep summers here long, hot, and dry for months on end.
This city began in 1872 as a small stop on a big rail line. It grew fast and was made a full city just 13 years later.
This city sits near the exact middle of its big state. A drive south leads to Los Angeles, and a drive north leads to the state capital.
Yosemite Park lies a short drive to the north of this city. Two more famed parks, Kings Canyon and Sequoia, wait east and southeast.
